verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-streaming and remote-control app. Bulk actions, such as removing many paired devices or acting on many windows at once, are a plausible axis for this kind of tool, so the story applies. The evidence only documents single-item actions: removing one paired device, forgetting one Mac by touching and holding its row, and closing or minimizing one window from its thumbnail. Nothing documents operating on many items at once, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
